I've been rewatching ReBoot, and I forgot how good the latter half of season 2 to the end of season 3 was. There were two moments that really stick out, and really punched me in the gut when I was a child. The first was at the end of Season two, when bob was launched into the net and then not even 5 episodes later, we get Game Over, where Enzo is "nullified"

Always wanted to check out Reboot as a kid, but never got around to it. I was a big fan of Transformers growing up and subsequently Beast Wars, so the animation style wasn't a turn off to me so much as the character designs, per se.

Any tips to a newbie as to how I could approach it and give it a chance? Just dive right in?

Watch the first 2-3 episodes of the first season to get a feel for the characters, then skip straight to season 2, episode 6 and watch from there. I'd suggest watching episode 9 and 10 of season one as well, as those introduce characters that will appear again later.

You're not missing much skipping so many episodes, as there's little to no plot in them other than Bob thwarting Megabyte's schemes and defeating the User in games. The overarching plot and character development doesn't really start until S2E6 anyways. Animation wise, once season three rolls in it gets MUCH better.

Be warned that Reboot ends with a cliffhanger, but the story continues in a comic that you can read if you're still willing to continue. If you are going to read it, watch S2E2 first, as that introduces one of the important characters in the comic.
